    getting-started

    getting-started.Rmd

    EmStanS

    Overview

    This package aims to support Embedded Standard Setting, calculating counts and weights.

    Install 

    devtools::install_github("sooyongl/EmStanS", dependencies = T)

    Usage 

    library(EmStanS)
    fake_data <- genFakeDataSet(ngca = 3, 
               cor_val = 0.2,
               n = 30,
               nlevel = 3,
               ntable = 5,
               npanelist = 5,
               sdinp = 1,
               ecinp = 0,
               100,300)



fake_data

# Or you can use your own data structured by the following table.
    res <- emstans(data = fake_data,
               grades = c(1, 2),
               location = "Loc_RP50",
               method = "weight",
               smooth = FALSE)

    Your own data

    An EmStanS Excel workbook (sheets Setup, Panelists, Ratings, ItemMetaData, ExamineeMetaData) can be passed directly:

    res <- emstans("my_study.xlsx", location = "RP67")

    Data in other layouts, such as CSV files, go through ess_data(). Only ratings and items are required. Level labels, SD and EC can come from a setup table, from arguments, or both (arguments win). Columns whose names differ from the defaults are mapped by name or by position:

    d <- ess_data(
  ratings = "ratings.csv",
  items   = "items.csv",
  levels  = c("Basic", "Intermediate", "Advanced"),  # lowest to highest
  ec      = 0.3,
  columns = list(ratings = list(panelist = "Rater", level = 8))
)
d                      # overview of what was read
res <- emstans(data = d, location = "RP50")

    Level labels may also differ by grade: levels = list(R1 = c("E", "M", "L"), R2 = c("B", "P", "A")). Every table, plot and report shows the labels, in level order.

    When the ratings include several rounds, each grade and round is analysed separately, and results are named by unit, for example R1-All Round 2.

    Plots 

    plot(res, "profile", "M1-All")   # inconsistency profile of the modal result

    Summary 

    summary(res)
#>     unit cut_level modal median average agreement weighted_kappa
#> 1 M1-All    Level2 131.4  139.2  150.16     0.600          0.400
#> 2 M1-All    Level3 254.5  246.6  239.54     0.600          0.400
#> 3 M2-All    Level2 152.0  184.7  178.82     0.633          0.409
#> 4 M2-All    Level3 283.1  258.5  262.86     0.633          0.409

    Report

    With what = "all", the combined report is provided.

    Individual 

    report(res, what = "individual")

    Modal alignment across panelists (by table and all tables)
    Median of panelist cuts
    Average of panelist cuts
